description:
An obsession born of love—is it merely obsession, or is it salvation? Han Jin-sung realizes his true feelings only after cruelly rejecting Lee Eun-jae, who once confessed her love to him. Foolishly, he becomes madly obsessed with Eun-jae after she leaves, but her pure, devoted unrequited love has already withered, replaced only by his own immature one-sided passion. With no room for pity, the man is ultimately abandoned by the woman.
